pub fn classify(x: i32) -> &'static str {
    if x > 10 {
        "big"
    } else if x < 0 {
        "neg"
    } else {
        "small"
    }
}

pub fn never_called(v: &[i32]) -> i32 {
    let mut s = 0;
    for x in v {
        s += x;
    }
    s
}

pub fn closures(v: Vec<i32>) -> Vec<i32> {
    v.into_iter()
        .filter(|x| *x > 2)
        .map(|x| {
            let y = x * 2;
            y + 1
        })
        .collect()
}

pub fn matcher(o: Option<u8>) -> u8 {
    match o {
        Some(0) => 1,
        Some(n) if n > 5 => n,
        Some(_) => 2,
        None => {
            let z = 3;
            z
        }
    }
}

pub fn early(x: u32) -> Result<u32, String> {
    let y = x.checked_sub(1).ok_or_else(|| "under".to_string())?;
    if y == 7 {
        return Ok(0);
    }
    loop {
        if y > 3 {
            break;
        }
        return Err(format!("small {y}"));
    }
    Ok(y)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    #[test]
    fn t() {
        assert_eq!(classify(20), "big");
        assert_eq!(classify(5), "small");
        assert_eq!(closures(vec![1, 5]), vec![11]);
        assert_eq!(matcher(Some(9)), 9);
        assert_eq!(matcher(None), 3);
        assert_eq!(early(10), Ok(9));
        assert!(early(0).is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    #[ignore]
    fn never() {
        assert_eq!(never_called(&[1]), 1);
    }
}
